dish.title: Persian Sabzi Polo with Seared Salmon: Herbed Dill Rice and Lemon
dish.description: Basmati rice parboiled, then steamed in layers with a big handful of dill, parsley, cilantro, chives, and garlic until fluffy and green-flecked, served with skin-on salmon seared until the skin is crisp and finished with lemon.

recipe_version.title: Persian Sabzi Polo with Seared Salmon: Herbed Dill Rice and Lemon
recipe_version.description: Basmati rice parboiled, then steamed in layers with a big handful of dill, parsley, cilantro, chives, and garlic until fluffy and green-flecked, served with skin-on salmon seared until the skin is crisp and finished with lemon.

ingredients.name: skin-on salmon
ingredients.display_name: skin-on salmon portions, about 6 oz each

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Rinse the rice in the strainer until the rinse runs nearly clear. Chop the dill, parsley, cilantro, and chives in a food processor with a few pulses (or by knife), mince the garlic, and mix them together. Pat the salmon dry and season with 1 tsp salt and the pepper. Cut the lemon into wedges.

steps.title: Parboil the rice
steps.body: Bring 8 cups water and 2 tbsp salt to a boil in a covered 4-quart pot over high, about 9 minutes to come to a boil. Add the rice and boil uncovered, stirring once, until the grains are tender outside but still firm at the center, 6 minutes. Drain in the strainer.

steps.title: Layer and steam
steps.body: Set the same pot over medium with 3 tbsp oil and 3 tbsp water. Spoon in a layer of rice, then a layer of herbs, and repeat, mounding it toward the center and ending with rice. Poke 4 holes to the bottom with a spoon handle. Wrap the lid in a clean towel, cover tightly, and cook over medium until steam escapes, about 3 minutes, then on low 20 minutes.

steps.title: Sear the salmon
steps.body: During the last 10 minutes of step 3 (overlap stated): heat 1 tbsp oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high. Lay the salmon in skin side down, press each piece 10 seconds with a spatula, and cook until the skin is crisp, about 5 minutes. Flip and cook until it flakes and reaches 145 F, 2 to 3 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Fluff the rice onto a platter so the herbs are spread through, set the salmon on top skin side up, and serve with the lemon wedges.

coverage_contribution: A third salmon meal (the others are a maple-mustard glaze and a miso glaze) and an HH001 fish dinner. Persian meals in the catalog are a lamb herb stew and lamb kebabs; this is the herbed rice with fish.
near_duplicate_review: Compared with miso-ginger-salmon: crisp-skin salmon with a green herbed rice, no miso or ginger glaze. Compared with maple-mustard-glazed-salmon: unglazed seared salmon with lemon, and herbed rice. Compared with persian-ghormeh-sabzi: herbs steamed into rice, not a lamb stew. Compared with persian-lamb-koobideh-saffron-rice: herbed rice with fish, not saffron rice with lamb kebabs.
not_duplicate_of: No tahdig crust is promised; the rice is steamed fluffy.
